desc: scip-search Operator Documentation: operator-facing documentation updates in `README.md`, canonical `support-docs/CONFIGURATION.md`, `support-docs/CUSTOMIZING_AGENT_TOOLS.md`, and a concise `support-docs/USAGE_MULTI_AGENTS.md` pointer for `scip-search` as a highly recommended external MAS navigation tool; documentation of `LIZA_ENABLE_SCIP_SEARCH` truthy/false activation, `config.scip_search` allowlist semantics, repeated `--scip-search <language>` setup, supported Go/TypeScript/Python indexers and external installation responsibility, task/project `.liza/scip/` snapshot semantics, graceful omission on indexing failure, `ast-grep` as the complementary syntax-pattern/rewrite tool, and explicit non-goals.
